items: [feature] The agent runs "Run all checks" and records the validation itself. `fab_checklist.py "<root>"` is the whole run (editor reads included); the button on the page is optional and no check waits for the owner to press it. When the kit cannot reach the editor, the agent reads the validation log with its own MCP and keeps it with the new `fab_checklist.py record-validation "<root>"` (log on stdin); recorded errors turn the check red.
[fix] "The editor was not reachable" now says where it looked (the address tried) and what the agent does next. A product with no Verse code still skips the Verse build (nothing to compile).
release.title: v1.123.11 — Fab: the agent runs all checks and records the validation itself
